description: This file defines the A11yController class responsible for managing accessibility focus, regions, sections, and user interactions within the Mattermost web application. It handles keyboard and mouse events, focus restoration, and visual state updates for accessible UI components.

classes.name: A11yController
classes.description: Main class managing accessibility focus, regions, sections, and user interactions for UI accessibility.

methods.name: storeOriginElement
methods.description: Stores a reference to the DOM element that triggered or last caused a focus/navigation event.

methods.name: resetOriginElement
methods.description: Resets the stored origin element reference to null.

methods.name: navigationInProgress
methods.description: Determines if keyboard navigation is currently active based on various internal states.

methods.name: regions
methods.description: Returns sorted and visible regions for accessibility navigation.

methods.name: sections
methods.description: Returns sorted and visible sections within the active region, optionally reversed.

methods.name: activeRegionIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the currently active region.

methods.name: activeSectionIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the currently active section.

methods.name: shouldReverseSections
methods.description: Indicates if section navigation should be reversed based on region attribute.

methods.name: focusedElement
methods.description: Returns the DOM element that should currently have focus.

methods.name: a11yKeyIsPressed
methods.description: Checks if any accessibility-related key (F6, arrow keys, tab, tilde, L, escape) is pressed.

methods.name: modalIsOpen
methods.description: Returns true if a modal with class A11yClassNames.MODAL is open.

methods.name: popupIsOpen
methods.description: Returns true if a popup with class A11yClassNames.POPUP is open.

methods.name: disableNavigation
methods.description: Returns true if navigation is disabled via region attribute.

methods.name: nextRegion
methods.description: Activates the next region in the list, updating focus accordingly.

methods.name: previousRegion
methods.description: Activates the previous region in the list, updating focus accordingly.

methods.name: nextSection
methods.description: Activates the next section within the current region.

methods.name: previousSection
methods.description: Activates the previous section within the current region.

methods.name: nextElement
methods.description: Sets the specified element as active, updating region and section if applicable.

methods.name: restoreOriginFocus
methods.description: Restores focus to the stored origin element, dispatching a custom focus event.

methods.name: cancelNavigation
methods.description: Resets active region, section, element, and user interaction states.

methods.name: setActiveRegion
methods.description: Sets a DOM element as the active region, updating visual state and focus.

methods.name: setActiveSection
methods.description: Sets a DOM element as the active section, updating visual state and focus.

methods.name: setActiveElement
methods.description: Sets a DOM element as the active element, updating visual state.

methods.name: setCurrentFocus
methods.description: Focuses the currently focused element and updates visual focus indication.

methods.name: updateActiveRegion
methods.description: Adds visual focus to the active region and makes it focusable.

methods.name: updateActiveSection
methods.description: Adds visual focus to the active section and makes it focusable.

methods.name: updateActiveElement
methods.description: Adds visual focus to the active element.

methods.name: udpateCurrentFocus
methods.description: Adds visual focus indication to the focused element.

methods.name: clearActiveRegion
methods.description: Removes focus and visual state from the active region.

methods.name: clearActiveSection
methods.description: Removes focus and visual state from the active section.

methods.name: clearActiveElement
methods.description: Removes focus and visual state from the active element.

methods.name: clearCurrentFocus
methods.description: Removes visual focus indication from all elements and optionally blurs active element.

methods.name: resetInterractionStates
methods.description: Resets all internal flags related to user interaction states.

methods.name: getAllRegions
methods.description: Returns all DOM elements with class A11yClassNames.REGION.

methods.name: getAllSectionsForRegion
methods.description: Returns all sections within a given region.

methods.name: sortElementsByAttributeOrder
methods.description: Sorts DOM elements based on A11yAttributeNames.SORT_ORDER.

methods.name: elementIsVisible
methods.description: Checks if a DOM element is visible.

methods.name: getAllModals
methods.description: Returns all modal elements with class A11yClassNames.MODAL.

methods.name: getAllPopups
methods.description: Returns all popup elements with class A11yClassNames.POPUP.

methods.name: getLoopNavigationAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the LOOP_NAVIGATION attribute value for an element.

methods.name: getOrderReverseAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the ORDER_REVERSE attribute value for an element.

methods.name: getFocusChildAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the FOCUS_CHILD attribute value for an element.

methods.name: isElementValid
methods.description: Checks if an element is valid for focus and navigation.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events for navigation and shortcuts.

methods.name: handleKeyUp
methods.description: Resets interaction flags on key release.

methods.name: handleMouseClick
methods.description: Handles mouse click events, possibly cancelling navigation.

methods.name: handleMouseDown
methods.description: Sets mouse pressed flag.

methods.name: handleMouseUp
methods.description: Clears mouse pressed flag.

methods.name: handleFocus
methods.description: Handles focus events, possibly moving focus to elements.

methods.name: handleA11yFocus
methods.description: Handles custom focus events for accessibility focus management.

methods.name: handleWindowBlur
methods.description: Handles window blur event, updating focus state.

methods.name: handleActiveRegionUpdate
methods.description: Updates active region on region change.

methods.name: handleActiveSectionUpdate
methods.description: Updates active section on section change.

methods.name: handleActiveElementUpdate
methods.description: Updates active element on element change.
